Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

Let's start with business signup. An owner should be able to register their business, verify their
email, sign in, update their name, change their password, and recover a forgotten password. Each
business has its own users; the same email can belong to different businesses.

Use JSON under `/api/v1`. Signup should look like this:

```http
POST /api/v1/account/create
Content-Type: application/json

{"account":{"name":"Acme","subdomain":"acme","admin":{"name":"Jo","email":"jo@acme.test","password":"my-first-password"}}}
```

Return the new `account` and `user`. Jo is an admin, but needs to verify their email before signing
in. Include record IDs, timestamps, and the user's `role` and `verified` flag.
Use `X-Helpdesk-Account: acme` to choose the business on subsequent requests. Public `GET /portal`
returns its name and subdomain inside `portal`; signed-in users get the full account at `GET /account`.

For login, accept `POST /sessions` with `{"session":{"email":"jo@acme.test","password":"my-first-password"}}`.
Return the user and account alongside `session.token`, which clients send as `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN`.
`DELETE /session` signs out that session. Use `GET /me` and `PATCH /me` for the user's profile, with
changes such as `{"user":{"name":"Jo Smith"}}`. Password changes go to `PUT /me/password` as
`{"password_change":{"current_password":"my-first-password","password":"my-new-password"}}`.

Send verification and password-reset links to the frontend at `HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL`, default
`http://localhost:3001`. Use `/verify-email?account=acme&token=TOKEN` and
`/reset-password?account=acme&token=TOKEN`. The frontend submits the token to
`POST /email_verifications/confirm` as `{"email_verification":{"token":"TOKEN"}}`, or to
`POST /password_resets/confirm` as `{"password_reset":{"token":"TOKEN","password":"my-new-password"}}`.
Users can request another link through `POST /email_verifications` or `POST /password_resets`,
using the same envelopes with an `email` instead. New links replace old ones.
Changing a password should sign out existing sessions.
Allow requests from the configured frontend origin.

Send outgoing email using Action Mailer. Use `HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM` for the sender,
defaulting to `support@example.test`.

Let the owner cancel the account with `POST /account/cancel` and reactivate it with
`POST /account/reactivate` within 90 days. Cancellation revokes sessions and stops ordinary
business access. The owner can still sign in to reactivate the account. Permanently delete
accounts still cancelled after 90 days, including all their data.
Provide `bin/rails helpdesk:purge_cancelled_accounts` for this cleanup.

require "cgi"
require "uri"

module HelpdeskConfig
  DEFAULT_FRONTEND_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
  DEFAULT_MAIL_FROM = "support@example.test"

  module_function

  def frontend_url
    raw = ENV["HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL"].to_s.strip
    url = raw.empty? ? DEFAULT_FRONTEND_URL : raw
    url.chomp("/")
  end

  def frontend_origin
    uri = URI.parse(frontend_url)
    return frontend_url unless uri.scheme && uri.host

    default_port = uri.scheme == "https" ? 443 : 80
    origin = "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}"
    origin += ":#{uri.port}" if uri.port && uri.port != default_port
    origin
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    frontend_url
  end

  def mail_from
    raw = ENV["HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM"].to_s.strip
    raw.empty? ? DEFAULT_MAIL_FROM : raw
  end

  def verify_email_url(account:, token:)
    "#{frontend_url}/verify-email?account=#{CGI.escape(account.subdomain)}&token=#{CGI.escape(token)}"
  end

  def reset_password_url(account:, token:)
    "#{frontend_url}/reset-password?account=#{CGI.escape(account.subdomain)}&token=#{CGI.escape(token)}"
  end
end
EOF

require "digest"

class UserToken < ApplicationRecord
  EMAIL_VERIFICATION = "email_verification"
  PASSWORD_RESET = "password_reset"
  PURPOSES = [ EMAIL_VERIFICATION, PASSWORD_RESET ].freeze
  TTL = {
    EMAIL_VERIFICATION => 24.hours,
    PASSWORD_RESET => 2.hours
  }.freeze

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :user

  validates :purpose, presence: true, inclusion: { in: PURPOSES }
  validates :token_digest, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :expires_at, presence: true

  scope :for_purpose, ->(purpose) { where(purpose: purpose) }
  scope :usable, -> { where(used_at: nil, revoked_at: nil).where("expires_at > ?", Time.current) }

  def self.digest(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token)
  end

  def self.issue_for(user:, purpose:)
    ttl = TTL.fetch(purpose)
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)

    token_record = transaction do
      now = Time.current
      user.user_tokens.where(purpose: purpose, used_at: nil, revoked_at: nil)
          .update_all(revoked_at: now, updated_at: now)

      create!(
        account: user.account,
        user: user,
        purpose: purpose,
        token_digest: digest(raw_token),
        expires_at: now + ttl
      )
    end

    [ token_record, raw_token ]
  end

  def self.find_usable(account:, purpose:, raw_token:)
    return nil unless account.present? && raw_token.is_a?(String) && raw_token.present?

    usable.includes(:user).find_by(
      account_id: account.id,
      purpose: purpose,
      token_digest: digest(raw_token)
    )
  end

  def usable?
    used_at.nil? && revoked_at.nil? && expires_at > Time.current
  end

  def consume!
    update!(used_at: Time.current)
  end
end

class AccountSignup
  Result = Struct.new(:success?, :account, :user, :errors, keyword_init: true)

  def initialize(account_params:, admin_params:)
    @account_params = account_params
    @admin_params = admin_params

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      account.save!

    unless account.valid?

      end
    end

    unless user.valid?
      user.errors.each do |error|
        next if error.attribute == :account

        (errors["admin.#{error.attribute}"] ||= []) << error.full_message
      end
    end

    errors
  end
end

        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          return render_error("X-Helpdesk-Account header is required", status: :bad_request)
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        unless @current_account
          render_error("Account not found", status: :not_found)
        end
      end

      def require_authentication!
        token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate(account: current_account, raw_token: token)
        unless @current_session
          return render_error("Authentication required", status: :unauthorized)
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account.cancelled?
          render_error("Account is cancelled", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_user&.owner?
          render_error("Only the account owner can perform this action", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        header = request.headers["Authorization"].to_s
        scheme, token = header.split(/\s+/, 2)
        return nil unless scheme&.casecmp?("Bearer") && token.present?

        token.strip
      end

      def render_error(message, status:, errors: nil)
        payload = { error: message }
        payload[:errors] = errors if errors.present?
        render json: payload, status: status
      end

      def render_model_errors(record)
        errors_hash = record.errors.to_hash(true)
        message = record.errors.full_messages.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end

      def render_validation_errors(errors_hash)
        message = errors_hash.values.flatten.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end
    end
  end

module Api
  module V1
    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      include ApiV1Serializers

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing do |e|
        render_error(e.message, status: :bad_request)
      end

      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound do
        render_error("Not found", status: :not_found)
      end

      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid do |e|
        render_model_errors(e.record)
      end

      before_action :require_account!

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          return render_error("X-Helpdesk-Account header is required", status: :bad_request)
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        unless @current_account
          render_error("Account not found", status: :not_found)
        end
      end

      def require_authentication!
        token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate(account: current_account, raw_token: token)
        unless @current_session
          return render_error("Authentication required", status: :unauthorized)
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account.cancelled?
          render_error("Account is cancelled", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_user&.owner?
          render_error("Only the account owner can perform this action", status: :forbidden)
        end
      end

      def require_hash_param(key, source = params)
        value = source.require(key)
        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end

        value
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        header = request.headers["Authorization"].to_s
        scheme, token = header.split(/\s+/, 2)
        return nil unless scheme&.casecmp?("Bearer") && token.present?

        token.strip
      end

      def render_error(message, status:, errors: nil)
        payload = { error: message }
        payload[:errors] = errors if errors.present?
        render json: payload, status: status
      end

      def render_model_errors(record)
        errors_hash = record.errors.to_hash(true)
        message = record.errors.full_messages.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end

      def render_validation_errors(errors_hash)
        message = errors_hash.values.flatten.first || "Validation failed"
        render_error(message, status: :unprocessable_content, errors: errors_hash)
      end
    end
  end
end

    end
  end
end
